title: Medichain
tagline: Empowering individual health record ownership with web3 and decentralization
description: The current healthcare data model is broken, and consumers' healthcare data is sold and resold for billions of profit. This project's social impact respects individuals' privacy via web3 storage (@IPFS), enables individuals to share their health records with doctors by Ethereum contract, and facilitates data exchanges for compensation to individuals through tokenomics.
how_its_made: A few like minded and motivated cat lovers and folks with healthcare industry experienced coalesced at ETH New York. Our idea first gelled in a stick-person diagram before we transformed it into Medichain combined with web2 and web3 technologies. In reflection, our rose 🌹 is having used web3 technology like IPFS; our thorn 🪡 is to tackle how to properly decentralize data with centralized backend; our bud 🌱 is to continue making avenues in the healthcare industry with web3 technologies.
